visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The scene opens with a main female character standing on the deck of a white boat under a bright, clear sky. She wears a beige zip-up jacket over a white shirt, black leggings, and a beige baseball cap. She is smiling broadly while holding two large, fresh fish—one brownish-yellow in her right hand and one reddish-orange in her left. The background shows a calm blue sea with distant land silhouettes. (2) The camera transitions to a series of quick cuts showing the boat departing from a harbor at sunset, followed by a close-up of various colorful octopus-style lures lined up on a black textured mat. (3) The female character is then shown actively fishing on the open sea, demonstrating the use of a rod and reel. She wears polarized sunglasses and black fishing gloves. The camera focuses on her hands operating the golden-colored reel and the rod bending under tension. (4) A male helper wearing a gray hoodie and a cap appears, using a landing net to bring a large fish onto the boat deck. The fish is then shown resting on the white deck near a black fishing gear box. (5) The female character holds up the first catch, a large yellowish Emperor fish, displaying it to the camera with an excited expression. (6) A second catch, a vibrant red snapper, is showcased in a close-up shot, specifically focusing on its open mouth and the lure caught inside. (7) The video concludes with a graphic end-screen featuring a portrait of the character in a floral frame with social media follow icons and red button overlays.
